verdict.rationale: Cerebras Inference is itself an API product. It documents a public REST API at api.cerebras.ai with a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec, official Python and Node SDKs, and OpenAI compatibility. It also has documented streaming, tool calling, structured outputs and batch capabilities, plus per-request API versioning and a deprecations log. Community users report driving it with an API key via a plugin. missing for 10: interactive in-page 'Try it' runner on the API reference pages (disabled), and the OpenAPI spec is not served at standard discovery paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Make your first Cerebras API call in just minutes.
This library provides convenient access to the Cerebras REST API from server-side TypeScript or JavaScript.
inference-docs.cerebras.ai publishes the Cerebras Inference API as a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document (server https://api.cerebras.ai, /v1/chat/completions and related endpoints)
Existing applications can use Cerebras by changing the API key, base URL, and model ID.
Cerebras uses API versioning to manage breaking changes to request validation and response formats.
